profile.headline: Experienced Full Stack Software Developer and Tech Leader
profile.summary: Although I have years of experience writing code, my interest is in the human side of software, understanding that a product is more than just lines of code. This encompasses both considering the perspective of the user at all times, and also ensuring that the team building it is working together and growing. I care deeply about equity and diversity in a tech environment and will advocate for anyone without a voice.

positions.title: Independent Contractor
positions.description: Added features to React/Django based assisted living management application. Refactored it to use redux and redux-saga

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Led development on and architected an Electron application used to produce Jellyvision's interactive experiences.
• Introduced tooling and processes to content production that resulted in a 60% decrease in major defects and a 20% increase in productivity.
• Led architecture planning meetings with a team of 6-10 engineers
• Paired with junior engineers to help them develop their skills
• Worked with other Principals and leadership to define company-wide architecture
• Gave internal training presentations on aspects of software development such as debugging, technical writing, and dealing with tech debt
• Co-chaired Tech Equity group and helped create a mentorship program.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Researched and programmed high frequency algorithmic trading strategies in a variety of futures markets, including Eurodollars, equities, and energy.
* Maintained software libraries used by trading strategies 
* Maintained backend trading code that dealt with connecting to the exchanges, placing orders, reading market data, and saving data to a database.

positions.title: Partner
positions.description: Developed and programmed high-frequency algorithmic trading strategies in the Eurodollar futures market.  Analyzed market data.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Researched and implemented high frequency algorithmic trading strategies in a variety of markets, including futures, options, equities, and forex.  Was the technical lead for several trading desks.  Worked with traders to develop new features, as well as maintaining infrastructure code.

positions.title: CTO
positions.description: Designed and programmed website for online retailer of entertainment goods.  Created back-end database and interface for order fulfillment.  Coordinated technology and provided technical support for office.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Programmed and designed online course software for distance and on-campus learning.
